script_text: Stop! Mars is squaring your bold ambitions, Leo, igniting a sudden shift in your creative fire. Remember, the universe mirrors your inner fire; nurture it, and you will blaze brighter than ever. Embrace this cosmic surge, Leo, and let your leadership radiate, inspiring allies, attracting abundance, and forging destiny with unstoppable confidence today.
